# Preface {.unnumbered}

This book is part of [**CamoGED**](https://github.com/MichaelCSHN/CamoGED) — an open platform
covering camouflage **generation, evaluation, and detection** across the natural-science,
military, and humanities/art perspectives and the physical, digital, and intelligent domains.

Its organizing idea is a single thesis:

> **Camouflage is a co-evolutionary arms race between a *hider* and a *seeker*.**
> Generation is the hider's move, evaluation is the referee, and detection is the seeker's move.

The book is written in Quarto: prose, math, citations, and *executable* code live together,
so every figure and table can be regenerated from source.

::: {.callout-note}
## Living document
This is an online-first monograph (`v0.x`) that will be versioned and assigned a DOI on release,
then submitted for formal publication. See the [project plan](https://github.com/MichaelCSHN/CamoGED/blob/main/docs/PROJECT_PLAN.md).
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
## Responsible use
Military-camouflage and adversarial-attack material is presented for understanding and defense.
See the project's [ethics policy](https://github.com/MichaelCSHN/CamoGED/blob/main/ETHICS.md).
:::
